sections.title: Keep it reusable
sections.excerpt: Keep it reusable | Prefer a theme that can cover every planned screen type rather than optimizing only for the first screen. You can fine-tune everything in the next step.

sections.title: Pick the visual baseline
sections.excerpt: Pick the visual baseline | Click a theme card to set it as the baseline for colors, fonts, spacing, and screen layouts. The selected card is highlighted and becomes the starting point for the Customize step.
